title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Asha Kumar
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency at RBAC v2 policy evaluation time; harden audit logging for cross-region key usage; include migration/backfill tooling and rollout plan.
description: Context: Several enterprise customers and audits require guaranteed KMS key residency and clear audit trails when keys are used across regions. Previously RBAC v2 allowed KMS policies to be configured but enforcement of region residency was left to runtime heuristics, and audit logs did not include stable key residency metadata. This resulted in a gap for compliance teams and an incident (SUP-4821) where a misconfigured key was used outside of its pinned region. This PR closes that gap by adding deterministic KMS region residency enforcement into the RBAC v2 policy evaluation path, improving audit logs with explicit key residency fields, and providing a migration tool to backfill existing resources. Summary of changes: 1) RBAC engine: when evaluating resource access for KMS operations we now consult a new KeyResidencyClaim interface that returns the configured residency region(s) for a given key and treat mismatch as a policy violation when the policy asserts residency enforcement. 2) Policy schema: added new optional top-level fields to rbac-v2 policy definitions: "kms_residency": {"mode": "audit|enforce","regions": [..]}. Backwards compatible defaults are preserve-as-audit. 3) Audit logging: operator/audit records for KMS ops now include key_residency, effective_region, evaluated_policy_id, and residency_decision (allowed|denied|audited) to make post-hoc compliance queries reliable. 4) Migration: a small CLI migration that scans existing keys and attaches residency metadata where the cloud provider exposes location; produces a backfill report and optional dry-run. 5) Tests and e2e: unit tests for policy parsing, policy evaluation matrix test for combinations of mode/region/operation; integration test against AWS KMS emulator to validate region-tagging and log fields. 6) Docs: rbac policy reference updated and migration guide in docs/security. Why this approach: Tying enforcement into the RBAC evaluation ensures that all access paths (hosted, dedicated, private) share the same compliance semantics and observability. Audit mode preserves user rollouts and allows Ops to detect issues before flip to enforce. Rollout plan: feature gated behind config flag rbac_v2.kms_residency.hardening.enabled (off by default). We will enable audit-mode by default for new clusters and run migration tool during maintenance windows prior to flipping mode to enforce for production tenants. Checklist: - [x] Policy schema change implemented - [x] RBAC evaluation unit tests - [x] Audit log fields added and validated - [x] Migration CLI + dry-run - [x] Docs and runbook updated - [x] E2E integration test with KMS emulator - [x] Security review (SEC-137) Complete backwards-compat notes: Existing policies without kms_residency remain unchanged (audit only) so no immediate breaking changes for customers. If a policy includes kms_residency: {mode: enforce} and the migration has not been run, policy may deny requests. Operators should run the migration in audit mode first. Related: SUP-4821 (customer incident), ENG-9142 (policy engine refactor).

review_comments: Ethan Park: Looks good overall. Two questions: 1) how do we handle multi-region keys (replicated keys)? 2) can we avoid a blocking RPC to KMS during evaluation?

Author (Asha Kumar): For multi-region keys we accept a list in the policy regions array; evaluation will succeed if any active region matches. For replicas we capture the effective_region reported by cloud provider metadata. To avoid blocking RPCs we cache KeyResidencyClaim and fall back to provider metadata if cache miss; cache TTL is configurable and we added metrics to track cache misses.

squash_commit_message:
security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region residency + audit logging hardening

Enforces KMS key residency at evaluation time; adds audit fields and migration tooling; updates docs and tests.
notes_for_ops: Gate is rbac_v2.kms_residency.hardening.enabled=false by default. To roll out: 1) run tools/migrate-kms-residency --dry-run and inspect report, 2) run CLI without --dry-run to backfill key metadata during maintenance window, 3) enable feature flag in audit mode for 48h and monitor audit logs and metrics (rbac.kms_residency.audit.count, rbac.kms_residency.enforce.denied_count), 4) flip to enforce mode and watch for increased deny rates and support tickets.
post_merge_tasks: Cherry-pick migration CLI to release branches used by enterprise customers
Coordinate with support to notify customers with policies that include kms_residency:enforce
Add Grafana dashboard panels for residency_decision and cache_miss metrics
Schedule a follow-up to evaluate any deny spikes and provide mitigation steps
